The lunch and snack concession is back and CAD or USD **CASH** is required at the competition for those wishing to eat on site here. **Calling for your volunteer help**. Those previously experienced as scramblers, judges and runners willing to gift some of their time are asked to e-mail [Lindy](mailto:lindy@flefc.org) to say that **of course** you're in! Volunteering is fun, engages you fully in the day and, with plenty of help, keeps the competition events moving along in a timely manner. A judging tutorial will be provided just prior to the start of the day. Anyone who volunteers- yes, parents, too- are eligible to put their name in our draw for little thank you prizes! See you all there and we appreciate you emailing in to volunteer a portion of your day.

items.information: NxNZ 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible (except 3x3x3 Fewest Moves). The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information: Los resultados de este torneo ingresarán a la base de datos y al ranking de la WCA, y quienes participen por primera vez adquirirán un perfil oficial. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. REGISTRO: El registro se considera completo cuando se ha completado el registro electrónico y se ha realizado el pago (precio y métodos de pago explicados en la sección de requisitos de registro). Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la pestaña “Horario" (Schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la pestaña “Categorías” (Events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. *Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago directamente con la tienda Speedcuber Perú al 991817714 o al 7505980. El registro permanecerá abierto hasta el jueves 18 de abril o y hasta que se alcance el límite de competidores. Sin embargo, **solo tendrán derecho a recibir polo quienes completen su registro (inscripción y pago) antes del 06 de abril.**

items.information: El torneo se realizará en el Salón Principal de la Escuela Técnica de Artes Visuales Cristóbal Rojas, en Caracas, Distrito Capital. **[URGENTE] Nos entristece profundamente saber que Venezuela ha sufrido un gran corte de energía desde el jueves por la noche, hora local. Las escuelas están cerradas por el día y se ha ordenado a los trabajadores que se queden en casa.** **Como hay un concurso programado para este fin de semana en Caracas, nos gustaría anunciar que existe la posibilidad de que [Cubearte Caracas 2019] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubearteCaracas2019) sea cancelado. Los competidores que se hayan inscrito recibirán un correo electrónico sobre este asunto en breve.** **Nos gustaría extender nuestras condolencias a Enrymar Cisneros (Candidato Delegado de WCA - Venezuela) y amigos en Venezuela. Se publicará una actualización sobre este asunto tan pronto como sea posible.** ***WCA Competition Announcement Team*** ______ The competition will be held at Escuela Tecnica de Artes Visuales Cristobal Rojas Main Hall, on Caracas, Capital District. **[URGENT] We are deeply saddened to learn that Venezuela has been under a major power outage since Thursday evening local time. Schools are closed for the day and workers have been ordered to stay at home.** **As there is a competition scheduled to be held in Caracas this weekend, we would like to announce that there is a possibility [Cubearte Caracas 2019](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubearteCaracas2019) will be cancelled. Competitors that have registered will be emailed about this matter shortly.** **We would like to extend our condolences to Enrymar Cisneros(WCA Candidate Delegate - Venezuela) and friends in Venezuela. An update regarding this matter will be posted as soon as possible.** ***WCA Competition Announcement Team***

items.information: The main event of this competition is 3x3 Fewest Moves. -We recommend that you arrive at least 15 minutes before your first event because there are no set times for each group. Por esa razón, todos los competidores deben conocer el reglamento de la WCA. REGISTRO: Se debe realizar el pago en la tienda TCG (The Cube Girls) de Lima, ubicada en Galería Brasil, Av. Brasil 1275, interior 66-A, Jesús María (http://thecubegirls.com/index.php/tiendas). Cada competidor debe elegir los eventos en los que se va a inscribir cuidadosamente luego de revisar la pestaña “Horario" (Schedule). Prestar atención a los formatos de cada ronda y a sus respectivos cortes y límites detallados en la pestaña “Categorías” (Events). Es importante escribir cuidadosamente los nombres, fecha de nacimiento o demás datos. En caso de no hacerlo de la manera correcta, serán rechazados. Para competidores que participan por segunda vez es necesario que hayan reclamado su WCA ID. *Los competidores que vengan de fuera de Lima deberán comunicarse y coordinar la forma de pago con el organizador, Alexander Esquivel CEL: 982527214. El registro permanecerá abierto mientras no se alcance el límite de competidores. Sin embargo, solo tendrán derecho a recibir polo quienes completen su registro (inscripción y pago) antes del 02 de febrero.

items.information: Auckland Spring 2018 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. Entry is free for spectators, no registration required. Competitors must register and pay a registration fee, see the registration page for more details. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information: Mind Games 2017 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience or skill, but there is a competitor limit of 60 people (FMC will have a limit of 25 competitors), due to venue constraints. There will also be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule, especially given the time taken by fewest moves solving. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

items.information: This is a WCA competition presented in conjunction with SkillCon 2015. Registration fees will cover admission for SkillCon; check the [SkillCon website](http://skillcon.org/) for more info on the other events and seminars that will be going on. Saturday will be a regular competition with 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 3x3OH, 3x3BLD, Pyraminx and Skewb. Awards for these events will be presented at the end of Saturday. Registration fee for Saturday will be $35 + $5 per event. On Sunday, single rounds of 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, Megaminx, Clock, 4BLD, 5BLD and Multi-BLD will be held as qualifiers for US Nationals 2017. These will be a chance for currently non-qualified competitors to get a qualifying result in order to be eligible for these events at US Nationals 2017. Registration fee for Sunday will be $35 + $5 per event Registration at the door will cost $50 and will be limited to 3x3 speedsolve only on Saturday.

venue.name: QBE Stadium
venue.address: North Harbour Stadium, Albany, Auckland 0632, New Zealand

items.information: New Zealand Nationals 2016 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.
